skill.summary: AITuber API skill for AI video creation. Generate videos with AI narration, visuals, and captions for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and long-form...

latestVersion.changelog:
ai-video-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release with full AITuber API integration for automated AI video creation.
- Supports generating videos from scripts or ideas, with options for narration, faceless video, stock footage, skeleton/character templates, and more.
- Allows browsing 1,300+ AI voices, picking styles, and customizing captions, visuals, aspect ratio, and templates.
- Includes bulk workflow: choose voice, generate video, poll status, export to MP4, and download.
- Added endpoints for video generation, voice listing, export, download, and managing subscriptions/credits.
